content_sections.heading: ANH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ANH Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ANH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: OBG: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India. Non-PG with at least two years experience in concerned specialty (in case PG Candidate not available). Registered with Delhi Medical Council. Surgery: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, Govt. of NCT of Delhi (ANH) for filling up various positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The available post for this recruitment drive is Senior Resident across specified specialties like OBG and Surgery.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available under ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Senior Resident positions in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand and can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to start from 5 October 2026 and continue up to 9 October 2026 at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Resident positions will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 67700 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS with a PG Degree/Diploma or equivalent in the concerned specialty and registration with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates appearing for this walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to check further details?
faq.answer: Candidates can check further updates, detailed notifications, and guidelines by visiting the official website at anh.delhi.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification of the attending candidates at the interview venue.
